effect: The remote test demonstrated drawing, steering and lifting the pen, completing the goal.
reaction: The looping whale was a pleasing use for the finished rover.

mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the curve and correcting the motor-speed mismatch made the trim adjustment understandable and worth the time.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed lever and remote attempts were repetitive because it was unclear that the paper test had to come next.

surprise.text: I was surprised that a small speed difference made the supposedly straight path curve, and that trim could correct it.

arbitrary.text: The required timing of the paper test felt arbitrary: the roll could not be used earlier, and the next step was not obvious after trimming.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: diagnosing the curved path and seeing the rover draw a whale made me curious about what the fair will become, though I hope the next sequence is clearer.
